items.text: Ketchup, pickles, cereal, one sock. It's a Ymamot Creation!
items.where: Ymamot Creation: little Amy in the flashback (Grace's voice)
items.script: [gleeful six-year-old announcing a recipe, bossy and proud; Ymamot is said YAH-mah-mott] Ketchup, [pause] pickles, [pause] cereal, [pause] one sock. [beat] It's a Ymamot Creation!

items.text: Yama-Mott. It's Tom backwards. We were six.
items.where: Ymamot Creation: little Tom in the flashback (Rose's voice)
items.script: [dry, matter-of-fact six-year-old explaining something very important; Yama-Mott is said YAH-mah-mott] Yama-Mott. [beat] It's Tom backwards. [beat] We were six.
